integrity: The proof uses the published factor-fiber estimates, the ergodic theorem, conditional entropy, ergodic decomposition, and the source's intrinsic-ergodicity result for variable-specification shifts. No finite experiment or external certification is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the marker-coded systems of Hong--Kim Theorem 3.7. It does not classify all one-sided balanced or synchronized shifts. A thesis cited by the source as an antecedent of Theorem 3.7 was not directly inspectable in the bounded source search, leaving a bibliographic residual risk for an equivalent observation.
title: Intrinsic ergodicity with a proper-support maximal measure in the one-sided balanced construction
